rename.from: Make sure Inflector::slug works the same way with and without intl
rename.to: Make sure Inflector::slug works the same way with and without intl or rewrite it

body:
Problems found so far:
- Transliteration depends on the language i.e. same input characters may translate differently for different languages.
- There are multiple translit standards for some languages. For example, Russian.

The code we currently have gives a bit incorrect results when using intl and incomplete/wrong results if intl isn't available. Since the task itself isn't simple and I assume there will be need to extend and modify it a lot I think we should convert it into transliteration component under i18n. That will be then used by slug helper.
Probably worth moving it to separate repository same was as https://github.com/cebe/markdown/

rename.from: Make sure Inflector::slug works the same way with and without intl or rewrite it
rename.to: Reimplement transliteration, modify Inflector::slug to use it

body: This is not a trivial work. I don't think we should or have time to spend on it to make it perfect. If we find a good 3rd party library, we can integrate it. Otherwise, perhaps it's better keeping it as is (while making minor fixes for known issues.)
The real issue is that current implementation interface doesn't allow you to modify the way transliteration happens. It's pretty much hardcoded.
No. I mean the method itself is kinda complex so if one needs to adjust, for example, intl character conversion rules he'll need to copy-paste the whole method.
Another issue is that what intl gives you is pretty much different from what we're giving out when intl isn't available.
It seems I've overcomplicated things a bit. Need to calm down and think :)
